changes.comment: `store.call()` takes `correlation: "either" | "causal" | "id"` (new type `CallCorrelation`). `"either"` is the default and unchanged: a reply matches by its parent link or an echoed `correlationId`. `"id"` matches on the echoed id alone, for a responder whose protocol carries its own request id and keeps several requests in flight on one channel, where a reply can descend from the wrong request and used to settle it. `"causal"` ignores an echoed id. `"id"` without a `correlationId`, or an unknown mode, throws when the call is made, before anything is emitted.
